summary: Full E2E test of IT Ticketing & KPI Management System. Backend: 34/34 pytest tests pass (auth, users, categories, tickets CRUD + assign/status/resolve/rate, dashboard, KPI, settings, reports CSV/PDF, audit). Frontend: All 5 role logins work (admin/manager/supervisor/tech1/customer1), dashboard KPI cards & charts render, tickets list (18 seeded) with filters/search work, ticket detail assign+resolve flows OK, create ticket flow OK, technician status change + resolve OK, customer scoped tickets + RBAC (customer redirected from /kpi) OK, KPI Scores page shows 4 technicians with performance labels, Settings SLA/KPI/Integrations save OK, Reports page renders with CSV/PDF export buttons, Users (9 rows), Categories (Hardware+Software etc.), Audit Log (37 entries).

minor.issue: pydantic EmailStr rejects .local TLD (e.g. admin cannot create users with @itsm.local domain via UI — returns 422). Seeded users use .local because they are inserted directly. Consider allowing test_environment=True flag or documenting only public TLDs are accepted.

issues: Uses browser's native date picker (<input type=date>) for From/To fields instead of shadcn Calendar component. Inconsistent with app's design system.

Login.jsx line 29 calls navigate() during render (`if (user) { nav(from, ...); }`) causing React warning: 'Cannot update a component (BrowserRouter) while rendering a different component (Login)'. Should be wrapped in useEffect.

action_items: Wrap the `if (user) nav(...)` redirect in Login.jsx inside useEffect to eliminate 'setState during render' React warning.

Fix PageHeader subtitle rendering: change wrapping element from

to

, or ensure subtitle is only text — currently causes hydration warning on TicketDetail.
Replace native <input type=date> on Reports page with shadcn Calendar/Popover component to match design system.
Optional: relax email validation or document that .local/.test domains aren't accepted by /api/users.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1176 lines — consider splitting into modules (auth, tickets, kpi, settings, reports) once >700 line rule matters for maintainability.

CORS config uses `allow_credentials=True` combined with `allow_origins=['*']` when CORS_ORIGINS='*'. Browsers reject this combo for credentialed requests; currently the preview URL happens to work because the response is same-origin proxy. For any true cross-origin scenario this will break. Recommend restricting CORS_ORIGINS to explicit list.
seed_data: If tickets collection is not empty, no additional seeding; if seed is partially populated, no idempotent update — acceptable for MVP.
get_current_user is called from every request but performs an extra DB roundtrip per call — acceptable; cache can be added later.
Login.jsx: navigation during render (see UI issue above).
seed_data_creation: None — used auto-seeded users/tickets. Tests created disposable TEST_ prefixed users/tickets that remain in DB (marked with TEST_ prefix).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. Frontend flows all pass. Remaining items are cosmetic React warnings and a native date-picker on Reports page. All data-testids match the spec in the review request. Seed created 18 tickets (15 original + 3 created during E2E). Customer1's ticket count went from 8→9 after test ticket creation. Multiple resolved-and-rated tickets exist so most customer rate flows will show 'Rated' state, not the rating widget.
